project_description: Define the cross-backend prompt-cache residency contract required by issue #342: provider-owned effective cache identity and lifecycle observations, bounded opaque renewal handles, model-aware backend capability discovery, explicit maintenance-control seams, host-only observation/provider-billable accounting boundaries, additive executable-connector ABI negotiation, and reusable conformance rules. Core remains provider-neutral and this foundation intentionally contains no scheduler or autonomous keep-warm policy.
